notes: No new stories created. Existing set already satisfies schema, logic, API, test, and integration coverage. Minor strengthening applied to manifest integration clarity.

change_log.value: Standardize how GPTReader is invoked by upstream systems (Brain runner, SIT, QA) by enforcing manifest-backed queries, validating against manifest_generator outputs, and ensuring consistent structured response formatting for downstream consumption.
change_log.note: Explicitly ties API layer to manifest_generator for stronger integration contract
Added manifest_generator evidence to support integration requirement

stories.title: Define GPTReader Manifest-Aware Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a strict request/response contract for GPTReader that includes manifest references, query constraints (doc limit, size cap), and audit metadata fields to ensure consistent and validated data access patterns.

stories.title: Implement GPTReader Reliability and Guardrail Logic
stories.description: Enhance GPTReader core logic to enforce limits (100-doc, 500KB), implement retry/backoff for transient failures, ensure safe truncation behavior, and validate manifest alignment before query execution.

stories.title: Expose Manifest-Aligned GPTReader Access Interface
stories.description: Standardize how GPTReader is invoked by upstream systems (Brain runner, SIT, QA) by enforcing manifest-backed queries, validating against manifest_generator outputs, and ensuring consistent structured response formatting for downstream consumption.

stories.title: Build GPTReader Unit and Integration Test Suite
stories.description: Expand unit and integration tests to validate schema compliance, limit enforcement, truncation behavior, manifest alignment, and error handling across realistic query scenarios.

stories.title: Standardize Audit Logging and Traceability for GPTReader
stories.description: Implement consistent audit logging across GPTReader operations including request metadata, manifest references, response size, truncation events, and error states to ensure full traceability and alignment with Brain audit expectations.
